comparison.objective: Detect a hidden pipe and drill only at a checked safe mark; unrelated to damper tuning.
comparison.physical_skill: Place and read a detector, select a safe location, then align and operate a drill versus unlocking and adjusting a retained collar.
comparison.success_condition: Drilling over the pipe or at any unchecked cross scores zero. Detection-distance, drill-depth, and alignment thresholds are absent. Candidate requires repeated safe stopping and retention.
comparison.reason: Tool use is shared only generically; sensing-before-drilling tests a different ability.
